title: Anatomy — a skill is a folder
text: Skill is a folder Claude reads before it works. This one is deadlines. The skill. MD file holds the full instruction set in plain language, no hidden logic. Claude reads it then acts. The file is the program. The pipeline sits in the step section.

title: Pipeline — how the skill works
text: Claude reads each step in order then runs it. Linear, no branching unless a step says so.
